Loads IPv4 routes from Linux netlink into a FIB and maps netlink errors to strings.

# Purpose
`fd_fib4_netlink.c` loads IPv4 routing table entries from Linux netlink and inserts them into an `fd_fib4_t` forwarding information base. It sends an `RTM_GETROUTE` dump request for a selected routing table, reads the reply stream, and translates each `RTM_NEWROUTE` message into an internal `fd_fib4_hop_t` entry. The translation code handles route type, destination prefix, gateway, output interface, preferred source, priority, and table selection. It also rejects cloned routes, skips routes from other tables, and marks parse or unsupported attribute cases with flags.

The file also defines the public load function [`fd_fib4_netlink_load_table`](<#fd_fib4_netlink_load_table>), which clears the FIB, performs the netlink request, iterates over the reply messages, and reports errors for I/O failure, interrupted dumps, space limits, or unexpected message loss. The helper [`fd_fib4_netlink_strerror`](<#fd_fib4_netlink_strerror>) maps the netlink load status codes to short text strings. Static assertions at the top verify that the internal route type values match the Linux `rtnetlink` constants.
